prompt: Usage-watch was refreshed at ~10:18 and it is now ~10:29 — about eleven minutes old. The 50-minute rule puts the next refresh at ~11:18. Do I refresh it again this run?
chosen: Hold it: an eleven-minute-old refresh is current. The figures were re-read from records at 10:18, nothing was newly under 25% or expiring within 24 hours, and re-reading the same figures eleven minutes later adds no information.
rejected: Refresh usage-watch every run so the timestamp is always fresh — a run that does not re-verify every budget is a run that let something go stale.

prompt: PR #73 census fired at ~10:24 (open, draft, unchanged, full open count 38) and it is now ~10:29. The next census is ~11:24. Do I fire it again this run?
chosen: Hold it to the ~11:24 wall clock: the census is a periodic read, and a five-minute-old count is current. Firing it again now would double-count the same state and burn a connector read for nothing.
rejected: Fire the census every run so the count is always from this run — a five-minute-old census is already stale and the board deserves a fresh number.

prompt: پنجره ZCode ساعت 04:30 تهران فردا بسته می شود، حدود 18 ساعت مانده و مازیار هنوز تصمیمش را نگفته است. نظر و راهنمایی را ساعت 09:05 داده ام. این دوره دوباره به او یادآوری کنم؟
